new-features.label: Mail merge
new-features.title: Merge letters from a CSV file
new-features.text: Start Mail Merge, choose recipients, insert merge fields and step through each recipient's letter.

new-features.label: Word views
new-features.title: Read, outline and focus
new-features.text: Read Mode pages through columns, Outline works with headings, and Focus hides everything but the page.
notes: Read Mode, Outline, Web Layout and Focus

new-features.label: Word design
new-features.title: Restyle a document from the Design tab
new-features.text: Themes, colours and paragraph spacing apply to the whole document in one undo step.

new-features.label: PivotCharts
new-features.title: Recommended PivotTables and PivotCharts
new-features.text: Insert a recommended report, chart it, and filter from the chart's field buttons.

new-features.label: Ink
new-features.title: Draw, replay and convert ink
new-features.text: Ink with a pen, play the strokes back, then lasso a sketch and turn it into a shape.

new-features.label: Animation Painter
new-features.title: Copy an animation to another object
new-features.text: Set an effect and its timing once, then paint it onto other objects.

new-features.label: Stencils
new-features.title: Make your own stencil
new-features.text: Create a stencil, add the selected shape as a master and drop new instances of it.

new-features.label: Add-ins
new-features.title: Upload an add-in manifest
new-features.text: Get Add-ins validates a local manifest and asks for consent before installing it.
